messages:
Morgan (Finance): FYI—we got a $120,000 annual prepaid invoice from CloudEdge, invoice date 2026-03-20, service start 2026-03-15. Question for close: do we deferral pro-rate from 3/15->3/31 and then monthly recognize, or treat as full-month start 3/1 for revenue schedule? Need journal guidance for MTD accruals.
Alex (RevRec): Prefer prorate from the service start (3/15) through the contract term. That matches ASC 606 — recognize over the service period.
Sam (Ops): Agree with Alex. Also note contract has a 30-day SLA credit clause; is that relevant for estimate of variable consideration?
Priya (Billing): Invoice PDF attached in the billing system. billing-bot: invoice 2026-CE-331 posted, amount 120000, term 12 months, start_date 2026-03-15.
Linda (Controller): For month-end journal I'll need the deferral schedule and the proposed JE. Can someone draft the entries?
Morgan (Finance): Draft JE idea: 
``
Dr Prepaid Expense 120,000
Cr Cash/AR 120,000
Then monthly amort: Dr Expense/Revenue Recognition 10,000
Cr Prepaid Expense 10,000
(Prorate March: 17 days / 365 * 120k = 5,589.04 recognized in Mar, remainder deferred)
```
Alex (RevRec): Small correction — classification should be deferred revenue (liability) not prepaid expense if customer paid us in advance. Use Deferred Revenue account. Also prorate based on actual contract days in term (365 assumed?) — confirm term end date (3/14/2027?).
Priya (Billing): Term end 2027-03-14 per the contract metadata. billing-bot: term_days 365.
Sam (Ops): If we switch to deferred revenue, JE for cash receipt: Dr Cash 120,000 / Cr Deferred Revenue 120,000. Then monthly recognition: Dr Deferred Revenue / Cr Revenue.
Linda (Controller): Good. For March close I need the accrual calc for partial month and a supporting schedule csv. Can someone drop the prorate calc and GL mapping here before EOD PST?
Morgan (Finance): I'll attach the schedule. Quick calc: 17 days recognized in Mar (3/15-3/31) = (17/365)*120000 = 5,602.74 (rounded). Remaining deferred = 114,397.26. Monthly thereafter = 10,000 except March partial.
Alex (RevRec): Add a note about the SLA credit: estimate immaterial this period; we'll monitor usage and record variable consideration if credits are issued.
Priya (Billing): Done — schedule uploaded to /finance/monthend/2026-03/cloudedge-rev-schedule.csv (internal link).
Linda (Controller): Thanks. I'll prepare the reversing JE for the accrual and include the deferred revenue balance in the REV schedule pack.
Morgan (Finance): @Linda one more ask — can you confirm the revenue account mapping for Cloud services (rev_gross: 4001)?
Linda (Controller): Confirmed 4001. Closing checklist updated. :white_check_mark:
Alex (RevRec): Great. If anything changes (discounts, credits) file a change request so we can adjust the schedule before close.
Morgan (Finance): Closing note: tagging month-end close channel in 30m for signoff. :clock3:
